Count Pestel

[Paul, Count Pestel; born in Russia, 1794; author of “Pestel’s Hymn;” became the leader of a secret society formed to introduce by force liberal institutions; executed 1826.]
Stupid country, where they do not even know how to hang!
When the rope broke by which he was to be hanged.
